Q9024.reason: The no-resist statute does not remove self-defense against an officer's unprovoked nightstick beating, so if the jury believes the suspect he is not guilty even though the arrest was lawful.

Q9025.reason: Zoning compliance does not bar nuisance liability, and a house that would destroy an existing solar use when it could be sited elsewhere unreasonably interferes with the owner's enjoyment of her land.

Q9027.reason: Civil law is the body of law that establishes rights between private persons and provides a remedy when those rights are violated.
